desc: In 1991, the Trijicon ACOG was chosen by the U.S Navy SEALs for testing, then operations. In 1995, German GSG9 SWAT chose the 3.5x35 model for their 550 rifles. Ever since, the ACOG 3.5x35 riflescope has remained a favorite among competitive shooters, law enforcement and freedom-loving civilians everywhere.
